clips.title: The story
paras: At Wellspring Lake, springs feed the river while corruption stirs the wildlife. The lake lies northeast of Darnassus, where night elf fishermen once found a quiet retreat.

Wellspring Lake lies between Darnassus and the Oracle Glade, beneath Teldrassil’s canopy. Night elves once came to its clear waters to fish and sit in quiet thought. Springs deep within the World Tree feed the lake, and its waters flow north through the Wellspring River. Now a blight troubles the surrounding wilds. Aggressive spiders, prowling nightsabers, and agitated timberlings roam the banks, making the shore dangerous for travelers.
